labeling.evidence: We employed formalin-fixed, paraffin-embedded samples (six RO cases, six chRCC cases) together with isotopic triplex dimethylation and a pooled reference standard to enable cohort-wide quantitative comparison.
For quantitative comparison, triplex isotopic dimethylation of primary amines was employed, distinguishing RO, chRCC, and a pooled mix that serves as a standard similar to the Super-SILAC approach.
